fields.description: How much to scale the output relative to the source resolution. The output keeps the source aspect ratio. Output frames are capped at about 14.4 megapixels (4K), so very large sources are upscaled by less than the requested factor.

fields.description: How the upscaler treats your footage. 0 (precise) preserves the source exactly and sharpens it — use it for faces, products, and real people. 1 (creative) restores and invents fine detail more aggressively — use it for generated footage, textures, and scenery, but it doesn't preserve identity as strictly.
